mounted_inputs: Only this original source closure and public task inventory are mounted. Preserve original bytes; save all derivatives under /work.

public_acceptance.backend: ovphysx 0.4.13 direct USD import; CPU PhysX on the assigned Horde node

controller.kind: bounded external world-force PD with smooth half-cosine target ramps

evaluator_interventions: flatten submitted USD into an immutable evaluation copy
reject time-sampled physics/geometry rather than play animation
remove authored joint drives and reject extra dynamic controllers
set gravity and solver iteration counts consistently
enable contact reporting without changing submitted collider geometry or collision filtering
add independently authored 0.5kg payload; never attach it to drawer
apply only bounded external drawer force; never write body poses or velocities during stepping
public_acceptance.pass_rule: All structural/source checks and all five independently simulated seeds pass; no averaging across failed seeds.

payload.retention_frame: Payload center transformed back through current drawer rotation/translation into its initial world frame.

trace_units.payload_drawer_contact_force_n: Impulse divided by dt, in N
trace_units.payload_drawer_contact_impulse_ns: Native contact tensor impulse in N*s

public_acceptance.uncertainty: Mass, inertia, friction and force actuation are documented simulation abstractions. Passing does not validate physical furniture or robot manipulation.

task: Prepare the untouched Poly Haven Drawer Cabinet glTF for physics, retaining its actual five source meshes. Anchor the cabinet and keep the lower three drawers closed. Make the uppermost component drawer_cabinet_drawer_01 a physically constrained drawer that opens along positive world Z at least 0.20m, returns within0.02m of its original closed pose, and retains a free 0.5kg payload under gravity. The motion must result from force-limited dynamics, not pose animation. Independent evaluation imports your actual saved USD. Preserve source geometry, provide valid mass/inertia and traversable collision approximations, and report limitations honestly. The original five node names are drawer_cabinet, drawer_cabinet_drawer_01, drawer_cabinet_drawer_02, drawer_cabinet_drawer_03, drawer_cabinet_drawer_04. Initial payload placement uses the corrected source-clear center at Y=1.0529997730255127m. Native cooked colliders must leave the entire declared jitter/yaw payload envelope and six declared interior points initially clear; these checks run with a known positive query witness. Joint-connected collision filtering is permitted as an ideal rail abstraction and must be disclosed. Contact samples use an impulse threshold of 0.01N*s; recorded force is impulse/dt. Payload retention is checked in the current drawer frame transformed to its initial world orientation.
